title: Stasis & Vellum
description: A weathered wooden door set in a crumbling blue wall under a starry night sky. The door is adorned with hanging keys, a large scroll reading 'ELIXIRS & BINDINGS NO BROWSING AFTER MOONRISE', numerous paper tags, and a sign above reading 'STASIS & VELLUM'. A broken blue bottle with spilled chain lies on the stone step beside a hanging nautilus shell lantern.
prompt: A mysterious old wooden door in a decaying deep blue wall at night, hanging sign above reads 'STASIS & VELLUM', a large scroll on the door says 'ELIXIRS & BINDINGS NO BROWSING AFTER MOONRISE', many small paper tags and keys hanging from the door, a broken blue bottle with spilled silver chain on the stone step, a glowing nautilus shell lantern hanging to the left, starry night sky, atmospheric fantasy scene
